records.footnote: 'na' denotes 'not available' or 'not applicable'.  '-' denotes 'nil' or 'negligible' or 'not significant'.  The industries are classified according to Singapore Standard Industrial Classification 2025.  Please refer to the Technical Notes (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/find-data/explore-data-themes/trade-investment/direct-investment-abroad/our-data-explained) or video on 'Understanding Foreign Direct Investment' (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/publication-resources/understanding-foreign-direct-investment) for more information on the methodology and concepts of Direct Investment Abroad.

row.footnote: The Information & Communications industry consists of Section J: Publishing, Broadcasting, and Content Production and Distribution Activities, and Section K: Telecommunications, Computer Programming, Consultancy, Computing Infrastructure, and Other Information Service Activities according to the Singapore Standard Industrial Classification 2025.
